response:
It sounds like you're pouring everything you have into being your best self—your relationships, your studies, your kindness, your values—and still hearing that it isn't enough. That's exhausting, and it makes complete sense that you feel worn out and hopeless. You deserve credit for how hard you're trying, even if the people around you aren't giving it.

One hard truth: sometimes no amount of effort will satisfy certain people, and their reaction may say more about them than about you. Your worth isn't determined by whether they're impressed. It might help to notice whose voice that "not good enough" belief comes from, and to start building your own measure of when you've done well.

If this hopelessness ever deepens or you have thoughts of harming yourself, please reach out to someone you trust or a crisis line (in the US, call or text 988). You've clearly got strength—please don't carry this entirely alone.
